An '''electric fence''' was a security system employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect [[Repair Station]] [[M13]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]]. It surrounded the base, and its low-voltage output was intended to discourage the predators residing in the area from encroaching on the facility.<ref name="Assault" />
